_comment: Hand-labelled support questions. Questions under the same key share one correct answer; a cache hit across keys serves a WRONG answer. Several intents are deliberate near-misses of each other (reset vs change password, enable vs disable 2FA, cancel plan vs delete account) because those are where semantic caches fail. Includes casual phrasing, typos and missing punctuation, as real users write.
